issues.message: This control overlaps a neighbouring control.
This element stayed in place when the page switched to right-to-left; it should usually move to the opposite side.
issues.fix: In http://localhost:4310/styles.css:5 (.promo), replace "left: 16px" with "inset-inline-start: 16px".

issues.message: This directional icon (arrow, chevron, back or next) points the same way in right-to-left; it should usually flip.
issues.fix: Flip it in right-to-left, for example [dir="rtl"] .icon { transform: scaleX(-1); }, or mark it data-fitlocale-icon="invariant" if it must not flip.

issues.fix: Isolate the value: wrap it in <bdi>, or set dir="auto" (or dir="ltr") on its element.
